# PregQuoteUsage

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `PregQuoteUsageInspection`

`preg_quote()` only escapes the pattern delimiter when it is given as the
second argument. Called with a single argument, a `/` or `#` inside the quoted
text breaks the surrounding pattern.

## Example

```php{2,3}
<?php
$re1 = '~' . preg_quote($needle) . '~i';
$re2 = preg_quote ( $host );
$re3 = '@^' . preg_quote($path, '@') . '$@';
$re4 = $quoter->preg_quote($needle);
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Pass the pattern delimiter to preg_quote() as its second argument.</li>
<li>line 3: Pass the pattern delimiter to preg_quote() as its second argument.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "PregQuoteUsage": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore PregQuoteUsage

/**
 * @noinspection PregQuoteUsageInspection
 */
```
